episodes.synopsis: After his showdown with Melon, Legoshi finds himself at the mercy of the ocean. Meanwhile, Haru encounters an unfortunate scene that rouses her suspicion.
episodes.title: A Threefold Dilemma

episodes.synopsis: While the drama club tries to get their interspecies script approved, Melon's interest in Haru grows. Later, Legoshi reunites with his canine friends.
episodes.title: Six Tails in a Row

episodes.synopsis: Jack confides in Legoshi about his struggles in school, while Yahya visits Deshico for a lead. Melon's fascination with Haru takes a dangerous turn.
episodes.title: In a Dusty Universe

episodes.synopsis: Legoshi awakens with a start to find Haru missing. The mayor approaches Louis with a meaty proposition. Pina stirs up trouble during rehearsal.
episodes.title: The Red in Our Lives

episodes.synopsis: Struggling to understand a herbivore's perspective, Juno seeks acting advice from Louis. Meanwhile, trouble brews in the Black Market alleys.
episodes.title: Sweet Hunger

episodes.synopsis: A quick meal turns into a moral conflict for Bill. Meanwhile, a string of unexplained interspecies attacks erupt around the city. Louis and Haru catch up.
episodes.title: Upon a Nest of Dried Noodles

episodes.synopsis: On the night of the Odd Soul Festival, Legoshi meets Melon in Haru's place, determined to stop him once and for all — but the villain pulls a gun on him.
episodes.title: Feline Fall

episodes.synopsis: With Melon on the loose, Legoshi arms Haru with self-defense gear — but he has bigger things to worry about. There's a warrant out for his arrest!
episodes.title: Gotta Buy a Step Stool

episodes.synopsis: After a charged encounter, Haru bonds with Gosha. Louis reveals his true feelings to his fiancée. Melon asserts his dominance over the Shishi-Gumi.
episodes.title: The Demon King of Beasts

episodes.synopsis: Set on challenging Melon, Legoshi enters the Turf War, but must first pass a deadly quiz. Meanwhile, Deshico makes a critical discovery in his lab.
episodes.title: Words That Slipped Out

episodes.synopsis: Louis's butler reveals the truth behind Ogma's behavior. Meanwhile, Melon incites the crowd and a riot breaks out. Can Legoshi survive the night?
episodes.title: Blood in the Disco Ball

episodes.synopsis: Despite winning the Doku-Gumi's approval, Legoshi must still face the Inari-Gumi's foxy boss. The mayor drops a bombshell that blindsides Louis.
episodes.title: Interspecies Exchange
